status: Independent local finite reconstruction of the proposed n=5 conic regular leading coefficient.
scope: Actual ordered words and raw pair-residue coordinates; no external downloaded code, no n=3 inverse, and no uniform rank claim.

case.coordinate_convention: Each old pair uses P=(r_i*r_j,-r_i-r_j,1); rows are actual residue components 0,1. Cross-point U/V coordinates are converted using cross=(r_j-r_i)P and the square inverse scale.
case.old_pair_row_order: For each listed pair, component 0 then component 1.
case.U_definition: Res_(L_ua)(Qhat_old)_c/(X_a*X_c) at X=(0,-r_ua,1), with both factors canceled before evaluation.
case.D_definition: On each pair vector z, return r_i*r_j*z_2*ell2, z_2=-z_0-z_1; retain components 0,1.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

case.outgoing_M0_row_order: (old block,state), block first; old blocks use the listed order.
case.outgoing_M0_normalization: Ordinary-y residues at y=r_ua of y*e0*P_s*h_x, -(x+y)*e1*P_s*h_x, e2*P_s*h_x at x=0; h_x=(x,0,-y).

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

case.Hlead_definition: U * solve(O,DZ0), with the exact O*Y=DZ0 equation verified.
case.limitation: Only the locally reconstructed finite coefficient is checked. Its asymptotic interpretation is a separate paper audit; no full source or uniform-n conclusion is made.
